howBytesWereMeasured.pixels: pdftoppm -r 300 -gray writing P5 PGM DIRECTLY, one page at a time, each render deleted as soon as it was measured because this container had about 2.7 GB free. -gray -png was never used: an RGB PNG is silently misread by a naive grayscale reader. The P5 reader written for this lane REFUSES any file whose magic is not P5 or whose maxval is not 255, so a format substitution cannot pass unnoticed. Ink is grey < 200 at 8 bits. Every source was rendered WITH annotations, which is pdftoppm's default; -hide-annotations was never used.

Ohio 3 pages x 2 fixtures, measured for ink presence and margin overflow (a composed pleading has no source form to difference against).

howBytesWereMeasured.verbatimDisclosure: A line-anchored matcher written in Python for this lane: a record string counts as line-anchored only when some single line of the delivered guide, after stripping a leading list marker or ordinal and bold emphasis, equals it exactly, or ends with it after a label prefix of at most 24 characters. Substring presence is reported separately. Whitespace-normalised matching was used for the Ohio defect strings, because pdftotext -layout wraps lines and an exact-string grep silently misses a wrapped sentence -- this lane's first Ohio reading did exactly that and was corrected.
